text:
Priya (AE): Heads-up — EnterpriseProspects Inc sent back the CAIQ workbook and called out a handful of blockers they need answered before the POC sign-off: KMS ownership/BYOK, separation of tenant keys, audit log retention and export, breach notification SLA, and availability of SOC2 artifact. Can we split responses + confirm POC timeline?
Alex (InfoSec): I can take KMS/BYOK and key separation. Need to know if they require HSM-backed keys (HSM required -> longer legal/KMS work). Any specifics?
Priya (AE): They said: 'HSM preferred but BYOK mandatory for production; for POC we can use Redwood-managed if we document controls.' So we need a clear POC note + production statement.
Maya (Solutions Engineer): I'll handle logging/audit retention and the POC config note. For POC we'll share an RBAC-limited instance with 90-day retention by default. If they need export we can enable S3 export into their bucket (requires cross-account IAM).
Dan (Infra): Quick clarifying Q: BYOK for POC — do they want customer-supplied key material or just customer-managed keys in their KMS? There's a difference (BYEK vs BYOK).
Alex (InfoSec): Good point. Priya, can you confirm wording from their security contact? If they mean BYOK (imported key material), that's a blocker for hosted. BYEK (keys managed in customer's KMS with Redwood wrapping) is easier.
Priya (AE): Copied from their email: 'We need BYOK (imported key material or HSM key) available during onboarding.' So sounds like true BYOK/import.
Dan (Infra): If true BYOK import is required, for hosted we need to coordinate HSM import flow and add an engineering blackout window. That will add ~3 weeks for ops runbook + legal ok. For Dedicated/Private it's straightforward.
Maya (Solutions Engineer): For the CAIQ answers I'll mark "POC: Redwood-managed KMS, documented controls; Prod: BYOK via HSM import - contact eng-infra" so Sales has both paths.
Alex (InfoSec): I'll draft the security justification language for the CAIQ items: key lifecycle, separation, key rotation, attestation. Also will attach SOC2 redacted summary. Legal-Bot: please note possible need for an addendum re: key custody.
Legal-Bot: Flag recorded — we may need a KMS addendum + HSM import statement. I will draft a standard clause and share in thread for review.
Priya (AE): Great. Let's put an assignment summary in the CAIQ workbook and get back to them by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (Solutions Engineer): Sprint plan snippet (for our internal note):
```
CAIQ split:
CC-ENCRYPT-01: Encryption at rest & KMS ownership -> Alex
CC-ENCRYPT-02: BYOK import flow & infra impact -> Dan
CC-LOGS-03: Audit logging, retention, export -> Maya
CC-PRIV-04: POC topology & data isolation options -> Maya
CC-COMP-05: Compliance artifacts (SOC2) -> Alex + Legal
```
I'll paste this into the workbook and label questions that require legal sign-off.
Dan (Infra): Action: I'll write a short ops runbook for HSM import and estimate timelines. Expect first draft tomorrow.
Alex (InfoSec): Action: Draft CAIQ answers and the SOC2 summary attachment. Will post as comments in the workbook by COB.
Priya (AE): I'll reply to the customer with high-level answers and timeline: POC config & timeline (2w for hosted POC, 3+ wks if BYOK import needed), Dedicated/Private options faster. Will cc @Alex and @Dan.
Maya (Solutions Engineer): FYI — if they want S3 export for logs, we need their bucket ARN + IAM role. Mentioning here so Sales can ask for these in the next email.
Priya (AE): Noted. I'll request bucket ARN and whether HSM import is a hard requirement or negotiable for POC.
Alex (InfoSec): One more: require an incident notification SLA note: 72 hours for initial notification + 30 days for full report unless contract says otherwise. Legal-Bot, any concern?
Legal-Bot: 72/30 is standard. If they push for 24/7 immediate notification we escalate to Legal for negotiation.
Priya (AE): Perfect. I'll send a cadenced reply after you post the workbook comments. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
